info.title: API.SH: Stocktwits
info.description: The Stocktwits API from API.SH: public Stocktwits data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Stocktwits message (body, author, sentiment, symbols, prices at post, likes, reshares, links, media) with its reply thread, and the parent message when it is itself a reply. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for older replies.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stocktwits-message

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page of replies.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Messages about a symbol on Stocktwits, newest first: text, time, the poster's bullish or bearish tag, author (followers, ideas, official flag), cashtags with the prices when posted, likes, replies, reshares, links and charts, with the symbol's profile and a bullish/bearish tally of the page. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stocktwits-stream

A symbol's page on Stocktwits: name, exchange, sector, industry, CUSIP, ISIN, logo, watchlist count, trending score, the quote (last, change, open, high, low, previous close, volume, extended hours), fundamentals (market cap, enterprise value, P/E, PEG, EPS, price to book, beta, 52-week range, moving average, average volume, shares outstanding, float, institutional holdings, dividend yield and dates, revenue, margins, assets, debt, cash, employees, business description), earnings (next call, EPS and sales estimates and results by quarter and year), crypto price profile and history for coins, community sentiment and message volume, the trending summary and topics, single-stock futures and recent news.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stocktwits-symbol

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
